ads.headline: Same-Day MRI Scan Available
ads.body:
A sprain that never quite healed, joint pain that keeps coming back, or an injury you've been putting off getting checked? 

An MRI scan may be able to help you find out exactly what's going on, and fast.

At Thomson Medical, our same-day MRI service is designed for busy professionals who need complete orthopaedic diagnostic care within a single day, no multiple trips required.

The process begins with an early morning consultation with our orthopaedic specialist, followed by your MRI scan when needed, and a follow-up consultation the same afternoon to discuss suitable treatment options.

Here's why patients choose Thomson Medical:
 ✅ Comprehensive diagnostic scans covering the spine, muscles, joints and other soft tissues
 ✅ A professional, experienced orthopaedic care team
